provider: Vanderbilt Department of Biostatistics; Duke University Cardiovascular Disease Databank
permission: The provider states permission is granted to anyone wishing to use the datasets; attribution requested to the original paper where identified and to Vanderbilt Department of Biostatistics.
attribution: Data obtained from https://hbiostat.org/data courtesy of the Vanderbilt University Department of Biostatistics. Cohort description: Duke Cardiac Catheterization Coronary Artery Disease Diagnostic Dataset, https://hbiostat.org/data/repo/acath.
target_definition: Significant coronary disease, defined by the source as >=75% diameter narrowing in at least one major coronary artery.

mapping.age: Years; same unit as UCI Heart Disease source.
mapping.choleste: Serum cholesterol mg/dL, mapped to UCI chol; missing values retained for source-fit median imputation.

role: Freshly sourced external transport stress test; endpoint threshold differs from the UCI source (>50% vs >=75%), so this is not endpoint-identical validation.
overlap_assessment: Separate Duke University cohort; no person-level linkage is available. UCI historical overlap is not expected by site, but cannot be ruled out through record linkage.
notes: The cohort-level target counts were inspected for ingestion/schema quality before writing the final experiment outputs. No model performance metrics from this cohort were used for method selection or tuning. Treat the evaluation as exploratory rather than preregistered.
